payload.title: Thu 11/5: Lunch at the desk, again
payload.purpose: The workday eating pattern, without shame, and what dietary guidance in the program does with it.

captions.LI:
Eating at your desk isn't a moral failure.

It's a pattern shaped by real constraints: time, availability, energy at the end of a long day.

At the Bariatric Counseling Center, dietary guidance starts with what's actually happening in your life. Our registered dietitians work with clients to build meal strategies that fit the rhythms of a working schedule, not an ideal one.

We don't ask you to overhaul everything at once. We ask what's realistic, what's sustainable, and what small shifts might make a difference without adding more pressure to an already full plate.

The program serves clients in San Antonio and virtual across Texas. Link in the first comment.

on_image: Dietary guidance that fits your schedule.
San Antonio and virtual across Texas.

payload.why_now: Thursday posts typically address end-of-week fatigue and the cumulative stress of workday routines, making it timely to normalize common eating patterns without shame.

payload.title: Tue 11/10: Referring providers: weight loss medications and the behavioral half
payload.purpose: Patients on weight loss medications (never the drug class abbreviation): the habits that keep the result. Document post.

captions.LI:
Patients on weight loss medications benefit from concurrent behavioral support to build the habits that sustain their results.

The Bariatric Counseling Center provides group and individual therapy, dietary guidance, cooking classes and movement education in one intensive outpatient program. Our team coordinates care with referring medical providers and, at patient discharge, we give referring providers a detailed summary of the patient's behavioral progress during the time in our intensive outpatient program, including changes in assessment scores measuring nutrition quality of life, disordered eating, anxiety, and depression, among other metrics.

The staff is comprised of a clinical psychologist, licensed professional counselors, registered dietitians, movement therapists, and a registered nurse, as well as a professional chef. One program, not four.

We accept most health insurances. Our Director of Admissions is Leloni Gonzales at lgonzales@bccsanantonio.com and 210-634-2200.

San Antonio and virtual across Texas.

#BehavioralHealth
captions.GBP: Patients on weight loss medications build sustainable habits through behavioral support. The Bariatric Counseling Center provides comprehensive behavioral healthcare for obesity in an intensive outpatient program serving clients both onsite at the state-of-the-art San Antonio facility and virtually throughout Texas. We provide group and individual therapy, dietary guidance, cooking classes, chef-prepared meals, mindful eating and movement education in a unique, all-inclusive format. The staff is comprised of a clinical psychologist, licensed professional counselors, registered dietitians, movement therapists, and a registered nurse, as well as a professional chef. One program, not four. The program can be standalone behavioral treatment for obesity, or in addition to bariatric surgery or weight loss medication that patients receive from their medical providers. Our team coordinates care with referring medical providers. We accept most health insurances. Contact Leloni Gonzales, Director of Admissions.

When providers consider referring patients for behavioral treatment of obesity, the clinical fit may be clear, but the coverage question lingers.

The Bariatric Counseling Center accepts most health insurances. Claims are processed under patients' mental health benefits. Patients typically attend for little to no cost.

The program can be standalone behavioral treatment for obesity, or in addition to bariatric surgery or weight loss medications that patients receive from their medical providers.

Our Director of Admissions is Leloni Gonzales: lgonzales@bccsanantonio.com, 210-634-2200.

San Antonio and virtual across Texas.

payload.title: Wed 11/18: Staff Spotlight: Chasley, Registered Dietitian
payload.purpose: Chasley, Registered Dietitian, Dietary Director. Surname must be checked before publishing (Fortune vs Pittman). Anti-diet framing in her words.

captions.FB:
Meet Chasley, Registered Dietitian and Dietary Director at the Bariatric Counseling Center.

Chasley brings warmth and expertise to every session. She helps clients build a healthier relationship with food without the pressure of rigid meal plans or restrictive diets.

"I focus on helping people understand their own patterns and make changes that fit their lives," Chasley says. "It's not about following someone else's rules. It's about finding what works for you."

Her approach combines nutritional education, practical meal planning, and grocery store tours. Clients learn to navigate eating out, plan meals that feel sustainable, and enjoy food again.

Chasley is part of our experienced and compassionate team. We serve clients in San Antonio and virtual across Texas.
